warmup.rule: first 60 frozen orbit poses, in order, drain; excluded from measurements

queue.l0: bounded benchmark fences; no application tickets or leases

paced.workload: full frozen orbit, settled-first/full, interaction, stress; absolute issuance
paced.incompleteRungs: P3 acceptance metrics unavailable; only full L6a default can satisfy acceptance
paced.profiles: Camera preview poses are drafts; the final orbit/interaction commit is settled; every discrete stress parameter edit is settled, matching workspace requestCamera/editParameter. Drain final full-quality commit before the next phase.

comparison.latency: paced draft request-to-presenter-completion p95 across orbit and interaction (settled milestones and stress replacement measured separately)
comparison.throughput: confirmed unpaced drafts/s; L0-L3 benchmark-completion rate is explicitly incomplete evidence
comparison.pairing: L from paced cells, T from unpaced cells, matched by manifest hash, scene, repetition, instrumentation and rung; both L0 brackets required

clocks.capture: nvidia-smi timestamp,graphics clock,memory clock,power draw,temperature at 1 Hz

unfencedCeiling.classification: separate diagnostic; never paired latency or acceptance

envelope.qualification: executor must verify active group work <=8 ms over all registered workloads; raw fences alone do not subdivide

acceptance: No incomplete rung can pass P3. Preserve all attempts, overruns need peer disposition before promotion.
instrumentedCompletion: Timestamp repetitions hold the common completion boundary through timestamp copy-out to bound query storage. Record this extra synchronization; never mix with plain layer-cost results.
